correctness.rationale: The proof identifies 20 unique filled neighbor triangles, 60 pairwise distinct edges and connected one-skeleton. Each triangle has a free edge, so integral H1 is free of rank 21. All 20 three-cycles are filled; exhaustive 4-set enumeration finds 60 induced four-cycles, all primitive by a direct integer cocycle. The complete 120-automorphism enumeration gives two 30-element geometric orbits. A 41x20 triangle-boundary coordinate matrix has a 20x20 determinant +1, yielding a genuine integral H1 quotient Z^21. Two selected orbit 21x21 minors have exact determinants +3 and -3 and each orbit has rank 20 modulo 3, forcing index exactly 3. Two mixed minors have determinants +1/-1 and give integral bases. The accompanying script reconstructs these facts from the defined graph with exact arithmetic.

value.rationale: The 120-symmetric dodecahedral graph and its ordinary Lovasz open-neighborhood complex are canonical. Shortest nonzero geometric homology cycles split into two natural orbit types characterized by an induced edge in the base graph. Each orbit spans rationally yet has index three integrally, and any one opposite-orbit square removes the obstruction. This is a sharp integral generation property not determined by the known 21-circle homotopy type or rational representation, with explicit small integer certificates suitable for further equivariant topological study.
